# Northwind Labs — Employee Handbook

Welcome to Northwind Labs! This handbook summarizes how we work. Last updated March 2026.

# Working Hours

Our core collaboration hours are **10:00 to 15:00 America/Montevideo**, Monday to Friday. Outside core hours you may arrange a flexible schedule with your manager. The standard work week is 40 hours. Overtime is paid at 1.5x for hours above 40 in a week.

# Remote Work

Northwind is a **remote-first** company. You may work from anywhere with at least 4 hours of overlap with core hours. We provide a **USD 150 monthly stipend** for coworking or home office expenses. Reimbursements are processed on the 5th of each month via Deel.

# Time Off

- Full-time employees receive **20 vacation days per year**, accrued monthly. - Sick leave is **unlimited** but requires notice to your manager before 10:00 on the day. - Parental leave is **12 weeks fully paid** for any new parent. - Uruguay public holidays are observed; staff in other countries observe their local holidays.

# Onboarding

Your first week includes: a buddy assignment, security training, and a 30-minute welcome call with the CEO. Laptops (MacBook Pro 14) ship before day one. Access provisioning is handled through Okta and typically completes within 24 hours of contract signature.

# Performance Reviews

Reviews happen **twice a year** (April and October). Ratings are: Exceeds, Meets, Partially Meets, Does Not Meet. Promotions require two consecutive Exceeds ratings and a written growth plan approved by your manager and skip-level.

# Code of Conduct

We have zero tolerance for harassment or discrimination. Report concerns to people@northwindlabs.example or through the anonymous form. All reports are acknowledged within 48 hours and investigated confidentially.

# Northwind Labs — Product FAQ

Answers to common questions about the Northwind platform. Version 2.4, February 2026.

# What is Northwind?

Northwind is a **project analytics platform** for software teams. It connects to GitHub, GitLab, Jira, and Slack, then computes delivery metrics such as cycle time, throughput, and review latency. Dashboards update every 15 minutes.

# Pricing

- **Starter**: USD 0, up to 5 users, 30-day data retention. - **Team**: USD 12 per user per month, unlimited retention, SSO included. - **Enterprise**: custom pricing, dedicated VPC, audit logs, 99.99% SLA. Annual billing saves 20% on Team plans. Nonprofits get 50% off.

# Security

We are **SOC 2 Type II certified** and encrypt data with AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. Backups run every 6 hours with 30-day retention. We never train ML models on customer data. Penetration tests are performed quarterly by an external firm.

# Integrations

Native integrations: GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Jira, Linear, Slack, PagerDuty. A REST API and webhooks are available on Team and Enterprise plans. API rate limit is 1000 requests per minute per workspace. Contact support for higher limits.

# Support

- Starter: community forum, 72-hour response target. - Team: email support, 8-hour response target on business days. - Enterprise: dedicated Slack channel, 1-hour response target, 24/7 on-call. Status page: status.northwindlabs.example. Scheduled maintenance windows are Sundays 02:00–04:00 UTC.

# Data Export

You can export all workspace data at any time as JSON or CSV from Settings → Export. Exports complete within 24 hours for workspaces under 100 GB. Deleting a workspace permanently erases data after a 30-day grace period.

# Northwind Labs — Expense & Travel Policy

Effective January 2026. Applies to all employees and contractors.

# Expense Limits

No approval needed under **USD 50**. Manager approval required from USD 50 to USD 500. Finance approval required above **USD 500**. All expenses must be submitted in Ramp within 30 days with an itemized receipt.

# Travel

- Flights under 6 hours: economy class. Flights 6+ hours: premium economy allowed. - Hotel cap is **USD 180 per night** (USD 250 in San Francisco, London, and Tokyo). - Daily meal allowance is **USD 60**; alcohol is not reimbursable. - Book travel at least 14 days in advance unless approved as urgent.

# Equipment

New hires receive a MacBook Pro 14, monitor up to USD 400, and accessories up to USD 200. Replacements are covered after 3 years or on documented failure. Lost or stolen equipment must be reported to IT within 24 hours.

# Software

Approved tools (Notion, Figma, GitHub, Linear) are expensed centrally — do not buy seats yourself. New tool requests above USD 20/month need manager approval via the #procurement Slack channel. Annual contracts above USD 5,000 need Finance sign-off.

# Consultants

Contractor day rates above USD 800 require VP approval. All consulting agreements must use the standard MSA template and be countersigned before work begins.

# Northwind Labs — Engineering On-Call Guide

How on-call works for the engineering team. Owner: SRE team, updated April 2026.

# Rotation

On-call rotates **weekly, Monday 09:00 UTC to Monday 09:00 UTC**. The schedule lives in PagerDuty. Swaps are allowed with 48-hour notice and teammate confirmation. No one is on-call two weeks in a row except by voluntary opt-in.

# Severity Levels

- **SEV1**: full outage or data loss risk. All hands, page immediately, war room in Slack #incident. - **SEV2**: major feature degraded for >10% of users. Page on-call, acknowledge within 15 minutes. - **SEV3**: minor bug or single-customer impact. Ticket, fix within 5 business days. - **SEV4**: cosmetic or docs issue. Backlog, no SLA.

# Incident Process

1. Acknowledge the page within 15 minutes for SEV1/SEV2. 2. Create an incident channel and assign Commander, Scribe, and Comms roles. 3. Mitigate first, root-cause later. Time to mitigation target: 1 hour for SEV1. 4. Postmortem due within 5 business days, blameless, reviewed by the CTO.

# Compensation

On-call earns **USD 300 per week** plus USD 100 per SEV1/SEV2 incident handled. Pages between 22:00 and 07:00 local time grant a half-day off in lieu, no questions asked.

# Runbooks

Runbooks live in the `runbooks/` repo. Every alert must link a runbook; alerts without runbooks are auto-assigned to the owning team as tech-debt tickets each quarter.
